Venues

Glasgow's theatre scene spans grand Victorian stages, converted churches, and artist-run DIY spaces.

Citizens Theatre

Gorbals

One of Scotland's flagship theatres, renowned for bold reimaginings of classic and contemporary work. Recently reopened after a major redevelopment.

Tron Theatre

Merchant City

A vital hub for new Scottish writing and independent theatre, housed in a converted church in the heart of the Merchant City.

Tramway

Southside

An internationally renowned arts venue in a former tram depot, presenting cutting-edge theatre, dance, and visual art.

Oran Mor

West End

A converted hilltop church hosting A Play, A Pie and A Pint — Glasgow's beloved lunchtime theatre series.

Website Instagram

The Glad Cafe

Shawlands

A community-focused cafe and arts venue championing grassroots music, comedy, and spoken word on the Southside.

Website Instagram

Platform

Easterhouse

Glasgow's dedicated venue for emerging artists and young people, with a strong programme of new work and community engagement.

Southside

City Centre
